mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increase > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates contraction in real economic activity, reducing corporate revenue outlook and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both decline in prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and GDPC1 both decline in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% annually) signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS growth > 1.5% in prior month) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth > 1.5% in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts level (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, supporting construction sector growth and generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200 thousand units.
